lifecycle.note: campaign/session0-redlines.md is a PROPOSAL draft (Session 0 红灯清单草稿). The safety content in this profile (lines, veils, confirmations, tools, protections) encodes only the statements already present in that source, preserves the PROPOSAL lifecycle, and does not promote anything to CANON. The data_handling declarations are B001 authority metadata (see derivation), not source content.

derivation.note: The safety content (lines, veils, required_confirmations, unconfirmed_default, table_tools, cognitive_pollution_protections) is derived solely from campaign/session0-redlines.md; the only additions are the machine-readable field names that carry the source's own statements. The data_handling block (participant_response_classification, persist_in_public_game_repo, remote_model_send_default, formal_game_input, stores) is NOT quoted from that source: it is B001 authority metadata — the mandatory batch-level data-handling declarations required for this batch.

lines.source_text: 精神疾病污名化：Line（不出现；认知污染≠精神疾病，机制文案须明确区分）

veils.source_text: 身体恐怖（变形/虫/自残）：Veil（淡化处理，不正面描写）

required_confirmations.name: 自我认知攻击/现实解离
required_confirmations.note: 本作核心机制，必须逐人确认可接受强度
required_confirmations.source_text: 自我认知攻击/现实解离（"你不是你""你的记忆可能是假的"）：本作核心机制，必须逐人确认可接受强度（0 不接受 / 1 只能模糊暗示 / 2 可正面呈现）

table_tools.x_card_detail: X 卡（或平台安全暂停）：随时暂停/跳过，无需解释
table_tools.new_redlight_term_detail: 红灯词清单：每人可加词，加入即 Line
table_tools.decompression_check_detail: 结束后的"解压检查"：一句话确认状态；高压恐怖局必做

cognitive_pollution_protections.false_information_detail: 污染造成的"错误信息"只作用于角色规则知识（游戏内），绝不对玩家本人使用（不搞现实解离）
cognitive_pollution_protections.fixed_format_detail: GM 给"污染条"时用固定格式卡（"你的角色现在相信：___"），玩家始终清楚这是游戏内状态
cognitive_pollution_protections.identity_alteration_detail: 涉及身份篡改的剧情，先征得该玩家同意再推进

data_handling.provenance: B001 authority metadata: the mandatory batch-level data-handling declarations (persist_in_public_game_repo=false, remote_model_send_default=false, formal_game_input=false, plus the HUMAN_PRIVATE_DATA classification and the stores flags). They are not derived from and not quoted from campaign/session0-redlines.md; see derivation.
data_handling.note: This profile stores no participant answers, names, or mental-health data — the stores flags are all false and remain false; the confirmation checklist declares questions only, never responses. Any session-0 confirmations or table feedback collected at the table are classified HUMAN_PRIVATE_DATA: never a formal game input, never persisted in the public game repository, never included in the manifest or packaged bundle, and not sent to remote models by default.
